newsitem.title: CHINA: China's People's Insurance profit almost 1.0 bln.
newsitem.headline: China's People's Insurance profit almost 1.0 bln.

text.p: The People's Insurance Company of China (PICC) reported a profit of almost 1.0 billion yuan ($120.48 million) in 1996, the Financial Morning Post said on Wednesday.
It did not say whether the profits were pre-tax.
Premium income from domestic and international business reached 63.4 billion yuan in 1996, rising 25.3 percent from 1995, it said.
PICC paid out indemnities of 35.1 billion yuan last year, up 41 percent compared with 1995, the newspaper said.
It said PICC hoped premium income would reach an annual 150 billion yuan in 2000, with total assets reaching 200 billion yuan at the same time, it said.
